一: One apple sits on one long line. Just one stroke, just one.
二: Two lines, an apple balanced on each. Count them: two.
三: Three shelves stacked up, one apple on each. That makes three.
四: Long ago this drew a nose breathing out. Now it's a box with two nostrils and four sides.
五: Five apples, laid out like the five on a die, held between two bars.
六: Six friends squeeze under one little roof on two wobbly legs.
七: A knife slashes through a hook. Seven's old job was to cut things in two.
八: Two strokes pull apart like a stuck door. Eight splits evenly in half.
九: A bent arm stretches for the last single digit it can reach: nine.
十: Two hands press together, all ten fingers crossing in a plus sign.
百: Under one line, a white sheet holds a hundred neat dots.
千: One person in the crowd wears a hat. They're one in a thousand.
万: The swarm is so huge you stop counting at ten thousand.
上: A marker sits on the line, and an arrow points up: above.
下: A marker hangs below the line, and an arrow points down: below.
中: A flagpole spears straight through the middle of a box.
人: Two legs striding along. That's all a person needs to be drawn.
今: A roof snaps shut on this exact moment: right now!
休: Tired out, a person flops against a tree to rest.
何: Someone hauls a mystery sack on their shoulder. What's in there?
先: One runner's foot lands ahead of everyone else. They got there first.
入: An arrowhead slips through the door. You're in.
円: A round yen coin rolls around inside its frame.
出: One foot climbs out of the cave, the mountain stacked behind it: exit.
前: You stand at the bow of a boat, pointing at what's in front.
北: Two people sit back to back, turning away from the cold north wind.
午: The sun stands straight over a pestle pounding rice. It must be noon.
半: A knife comes down the middle of a cow, splitting it in half.
南: A big bell rings out across the warm south.
友: Two hands reach out and clasp. That's a friend.
右: Your right hand lifts food to your mouth.
左: Your left hand steadies the ruler while the right one works.
名: In the dark evening no one can see you, so you call out your name.
国: A jewel sits safe inside a border wall. That's a country.
土: A sprout pushes up from a mound of earth.
外: The moon is out and the fortune-teller works outside.
大: A person stretches arms and legs as wide as they go: this big!
天: Above the big person's head, one line marks the sky.
女: A woman kneels gracefully, her arms folded across her lap.
子: A swaddled baby waves two little arms.
学: A child sits under the school roof while knowledge drops down from above.
小: A line stands between two tiny specks. Everything here is small.
山: Three peaks in a row, the tallest in the middle.
川: Three lines of water run down the river, with a fish along for the ride.
年: A farmer carries the wheat home. One harvest, one year.
後: Someone shuffles behind on the road, a foot tied up by rope.
日: The old round sun got boxed in by scribes, with a line across its bright middle.
時: Beside the sun, the temple bell rings out the time.
書: A hand grips a brush over the page, writing in the daylight.
月: A crescent moon peeks out from behind its two cloud lines.
木: A trunk, branches reaching out and roots spreading below: a tree.
本: A line marks the root of the tree, the origin of a good book.
来: Wheat arrives from the sky, a gift that has come at last.
東: The sun rises behind a tree. Face it and you're looking east.
校: Friends mix together in a little wooden school.
母: A mother holds her baby close, two dots of love in her arms.
毎: Every single person has a mother, every day of the calendar.
気: Steam curls up from the rice, unseen energy in the air.
水: A stream runs down the middle while drops splash out both sides.
火: A person-shaped flame leaps up, a spark flying off each side.
父: Dad swings a stone axe, two sparks flying from the blade.
生: A green sprout breaks through the ground. New life!
男: A man flexes his strength above the rice field.
白: One ray glints off the sun, so bright it turns white.
聞: An ear presses against the gate, listening in.
行: A crossroads seen from above. Pick a road and go.
西: As the sun sinks, birds fly back to the nest. That way is west.
見: A giant eye walks around on two legs, seeing everything.
話: Words roll off the tongue as you talk.
語: Words that I speak become my language.
読: Say the words aloud, like selling your story to the room: read.
車: Look down on a cart: two wheels joined by one long axle.
金: Two gold nuggets glitter under a roof of earth.
長: An elder with hair so long it trails past their cane.
間: Sunlight slips through the gap between two gate doors.
雨: Raindrops fall from under a cloud, trapped below the sky.
電: Lightning shoots from a rain cloud. That's electricity.
食: A lid lifts off a steaming bowl of rice. Time to eat.
高: A tower with its roof, windows and gate rises high above the clouds.
不: A line blocks the flower from growing up. No, it can't.
世: Three tens joined together make thirty years, one generation of the world.
主: A flame burns on top of the lamp stand, watched by the master of the house.
事: A hand raises the flag on a pole: time to get on with the job.
京: A grand palace rises over the city. Welcome to the capital.
仕: A person bows to serve their lord like a loyal samurai.
代: The tired guard hands over to a substitute at the post.
以: A person uses a cart to get the load moving, by means of wheels.
会: People gather under one roof to meet, chatter rising like a cloud.
住: A person lives where they're master of the house.
体: A person and their root: the body is where you begin.
作: A person suddenly gets to work and makes something.
使: A boss sends a messenger running, using them for the mission.
借: A person holds out a book they borrowed long ago.
元: A figure throws up two arms under two lines: the head, where it all begins.
兄: A big mouth on two legs: your older brother giving orders.
公: Private things split open under the park sign, for everyone to see.
写: Slide the page under a cover, and out comes a copy.
冬: Slow feet trudge through two drops of ice in the winter snow.
切: Seven slices with a knife, and the apple is cut.
別: Two friends walk apart, a knife slicing between them.
力: An arm flexes its muscle. Feel the power.
勉: Even with a perfect excuse, you use your strength to study.
動: It's heavy, so put your strength behind it and move.
医: An arrow goes back in the box: the doctor has done the job.
去: A person leaves the house and runs off down the road.
口: A mouth wide open, teeth and tongue showing, drawn square.
古: Ten mouths have retold this story. It must be old.
台: A nose over a mouth, up on a stage: a speaker's stand.
同: Two matching friends stand inside one frame: the same.
味: One bite of fruit that's not quite ripe, and your mouth tastes it.
品: Three boxes stacked on a shelf: goods.
員: A mouth over a shell, the old money: staff who get paid.
問: A mouth at the gate calls out a question.
図: A map, drawn inside its border.
地: A road snakes across the earth, over the ground.
堂: A grand hall stands on a raised platform of earth.
場: The sun rises over open earth: this is the place.
売: A samurai stands at the shop counter, selling things off.
夏: You drag your feet under the scorching summer sun.
夕: A sliver of moon appears as the day ends: evening.
多: Two slabs of meat pile up. That's a lot!
夜: The moon rises while someone sleeps under the roof: night.
妹: A girl not yet grown: your little sister.
姉: A woman heads to the market for the family: your big sister.
始: She steps up to the stand and the race begins.
字: A child sits under a roof, practising characters.
安: A woman sits safe under her own roof, at peace.
室: You arrive under the roof and you're in the room.
家: A pig under a roof: in old farmhouses, the pig meant home.
少: Slice a bit off something small and there's even less.
屋: Arrive under the awning: a house with a shop out front.
工: A carpenter's ruler: straight line on top, straight line below, a craft between.
帰: Broom in hand, someone heads back home to sweep up.
広: Stretch out your arms under a huge roof. It's so wide.
店: A fortune-teller sets up under an awning: open for business.
度: A hand measures under a roof: how many degrees?
建: A worker carries bricks with long strides, building a tower.
弟: Lined up by height, your little brother comes next.
強: A tiny bug draws a giant bow. How strong!
待: Stand on the road by the temple and wait.
心: A heart with little drops of feeling beating around it.
思: A field of thoughts grows on top of your heart.
急: A hand grabs your heart as the clock ticks: hurry!
悪: A ghost hides in a dark heart. That's bad.
意: Listen to the sound of your heart, and you find your idea.
手: An open hand, its fingers spread across the wrist.
持: A hand carries an offering to the temple: hold on tight.
教: A teacher with a pointer shows a child how it's done.
文: A person with a pattern on their chest. The first marks became writing.
料: Scoop rice with a dipper to work out the fee.
新: The axe bites into a fresh tree: new wood.
方: A signpost points the way: which direction?
旅: Bags packed, friends follow the flag on a journey.
族: A whole family gathers under one flag.
早: The sun peeks over a sprout: still early.
明: Sun and moon side by side: as bright as it gets.
映: The sun sits in the centre, reflected across the water.
春: Sunshine wakes the flowers under the grass: spring.
昼: Measure the day from dawn. By lunch, the sun is overhead.
曜: A pheasant's feathers shine like the planets that name the days of the week.
有: A hand reaches for the meat. Now you have it.
服: Shirts on hangers, clothes for every body.
朝: The sun climbs through the grass while the moon still hangs on: morning.
業: A worker bends over the charts: this is the business.
楽: Bells on a wooden stand ring out. Music is fun!
歌: Two mouths open wide into a microphone: a song.
止: A footprint planted on the ground. Stop right there.
正: A foot stops right on the line: exactly correct.
歩: One foot stops, the next steps on. That's walking.
死: A bone lies beside a kneeling ghost: death.
注: The master of the house pours water, carefully, into the cup.
洋: Sheep-white waves roll across the ocean.
海: Every river's water ends up here: the sea.
漢: The Han river flows past the castle: the name of old China.
牛: A cow's face from the front: a line across for horns.
物: Boxes, apples and gems, each flagged as a thing you own.
特: A prize cow at the temple, picked out as special.
犬: A big dog with one dot for a perky ear.
理: Polishing jade reveals its grain, and the logic inside it.
用: A sturdy rack of poles, ready to use.
田: A rice field cut into four neat plots.
町: A road runs through the fields, and a town grows along it.
画: A brush frames a field in a picture.
界: A flag between two fields marks the boundary of the world.
病: Burning with fever, you lie sick in bed.
発: The bowstring snaps and the arrow takes off.
目: An eye, turned on its side, pupil in the middle.
真: Under the magnifying glass, it proves true.
着: Sheep's wool in your eye means it's time to wear a coat.
知: An arrow of knowledge flies out of the mouth.
研: Rub a stone until it's even, and the gem starts to shine.
社: A shrine stands on the soil, where the community met. Today, a company.
私: Hand on my own heart, this grain is private. It's mine.
秋: Fire burns off the fields after the wheat is in: autumn.
究: Go nine times down the hole with a magnifying glass: research.
空: A hole in the clouds opens to the empty sky.
立: A person stands on the ground, arms out, feet planted.
答: A question goes in, an answer pops out: a perfect fit.
紙: Threads pressed flat turn into a sheet of paper.
終: The cord ends with a knot in winter, and the flag comes down: the end.
習: A chick spreads white wings again and again, learning to fly.
考: An elder leans on a cane, deep in thought.
者: An elder walks under the sun: someone we all know.
肉: Ribs in a slice of meat.
自: A nose: in Japan, you point at your nose to say myself.
色: Flowers of every colour burst across the meadow.
英: The finest bloom in the grass, a hero with a crown. And, by sound, England.
茶: Grass over a person under a tree: picking leaves for tea.
親: A parent stands on a tree, watching for the kids to come home.
言: Words spill from a mouth in a stack of lines.
計: Say numbers out loud up to ten: counting out the plan.
試: Words on paper against the clock: it's a test.
買: A bag of shells, the old money, is all you need to buy things.
貸: Hand over a book as a stand-in for a shell of money: lending.
質: Two axes weigh in on a shell: what's its quality?
赤: A person glows red beside the fire.
走: A person pumps their arms, feet flying: run!
起: Sun's up! Run yourself out of bed and wake up.
足: A knee on top, a foot below: the whole leg.
転: A cart's wheel rolls and turns.
近: The axe is just down the road, so close you can reach it.
送: Walk them to the station and send them off with a parcel.
通: Walk down the path and pass right through.
週: Go round the road, and the same week comes around again.
運: An army on the march hauls its carts along: carry.
道: A head walks along the road, finding the way.
重: A person staggers under a huge box. So heavy!
野: Past the village, open fields of grass and wildflowers.
銀: A stubborn metal that refuses to lose its shine: silver.
開: Two hands lift the bar and the gate swings open.
院: A complete set of buildings on the hill: an institution.
集: Birds flock to one tree and gather.
青: A plant grows under the moon, its colour between blue and green.
音: A bell rings, the sound standing up over the sun.
題: A head bent over the page asks what the topic is.
風: A bug tumbles along under a sail in the wind.
飯: Food that fights back against hunger: a bowl of rice.
飲: Open wide and gulp it down.
館: A big building where officials eat: a grand hall.
駅: Riders once swapped horses here, measured stop by stop. Now, a train station.
験: A horse put to the test while the clock runs.
魚: A fish: head, scaly body, and the four dots of its tail.
鳥: A bird with a head, body and tail, standing on four toes.
黒: Fire burns under the village until soot turns everything black.
